description.zh:
是否允许共享给资源目录外的账号。取值：

- false（默认值）：仅允许资源目录内共享。
- true：允许共享给任意账号。
description.en:
Specifies whether to allow sharing with accounts outside your resource directory. Valid values:

- `false` (default): Resources can be shared only with accounts within your resource directory.

- `true`: Resources can be shared with any Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 共享权限名称。为空时，系统自动绑定资源类型关联的默认权限。具体信息，请参见[权限库](~~465474~~)。
description.en: The name of the permission. If unspecified, the system attaches the default permission for the resource type. For details, see [Permission Library](~~465474~~).

description.zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Names (ARNs) of the shared resources.

You can add up to five shared resources at a time.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
共享单元名称。

长度范围：1~50个字符。

格式：允许输入英文字母、数字、中文、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the resource share.

The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.

It can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

> `Resources.N.ResourceId`与`Resources.N.ResourceType`成对出现，需要同时设置。
description.en:
The ID of the shared resource.

You can add up to five shared resources at a time.

> Specify the `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` parameters in pairs.

description.zh:
共享资源类型。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务](~~450526~~)。

> `Resources.N.ResourceId`与`Resources.N.ResourceType`成对出现，需要同时设置。
description.en:
The type of the shared resource.

You can add up to five shared resources at a time.

For a list of supported resource types, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing](~~450526~~).

> Specify the `Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` parameters in pairs.

description.zh: 标签列表。最多可以绑定 20 个标签。
description.en: The tags of the resource share. You can add a maximum of 20 tags.

description.zh:
标签键。
> 最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key.

> The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
标签值。
> 最多支持 128 个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value.

> The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源使用者属性。
> 仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时可以设置该参数。
description.en:
The properties of the principal.

> This parameter is available only when the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service.

descriptions.zh:
阿里云资源共享（Resource Sharing）支持将一个账号下的指定资源共享给一个或多个目标账号使用。更多信息，请参见[资源共享概述](~~160622~~)。

本文将提供一个示例，在`cn-hangzhou`地域，使用资源目录管理账号创建一个名为`test`的共享单元，将VPC交换机`vsw-bp183p93qs667muql****`共享给资源目录内的成员`172050525300****`。
descriptions.en:
Alibaba Cloud Resource Sharing lets you share resources from your account with one or more Principals. For more information, see [Resource Sharing overview](~~160622~~).

This example shows how to use the management account of a Resource Directory to create a resource share named `test` in the `cn-hangzhou` region and share the vSwitch `vsw-bp183p93qs667muql****` with member `172050525300****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcesharing create-resource-share --resource-share-name test --resources ResourceId=vsw-bp183p93qs667muql0000 ResourceType=VSwitch --targets 1720505253000000 --resource-arns acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000 --permission-names AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch --allow-external-targets false --resource-group-id rg-aekz5nlvlak0000 --target-properties Property=timeRange_:_timeRangeType_:_timeRange_,_beginAtTime_:_00:00_,_timezone_:_UTC+8_,_endAtTime_:_19:59 TargetId=1720505253000000 --resource-properties ResourceArn=acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000 Property=sharePrincipals_:true,_shareTagOptions_:false --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcesharing CreateResourceShare --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceShareName test --Resources.1.ResourceId 'vsw-bp183p93qs667muql0000' --Tag.1.Key k1 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz5nlvlak0000' --ResourceProperties.1.ResourceArn 'acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000' --PermissionNames.1 AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch --AllowExternalTargets false --ResourceArns.1 'acs:vpc:cn-shanghai:1037554691870000:vswitch/vsw-uf62b11ue4m8oz2di0000' --ResourceProperties.1.Property 'sharePrincipals_:true,_shareTagOptions_:false' --Targets.1 1720505253000000 --TargetProperties.1.TargetId 1720505253000000 --Tag.1.Value v1 --TargetProperties.1.Property 'timeRange_:_timeRangeType_:_timeRange_,_beginAtTime_:_00:00_,_timezone_:_UTC+8_,_endAtTime_:_19:59' --Resources.1.ResourceType VSwitch --method POST --force
